Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, but you can note that I was the driver of the vehicle.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was turning left, heading toward a shopping center.
Q: What was the traffic signal doing when you started your turn?
A: The light had turned yellow, and I was trying to clear the intersection before it changed. I believe the oncoming
vehicle was already coming through.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?
A: Not clearly. I looked, but the glare from the sun was bad that morning, and I only saw it a secnod before we hit.
Q: How fast were you going when you began the turn?
A: I'd say slow, maybe ten or fifteen miles per hour. I was almost at a stop in the turn lane.
Q: Where did your body make contact with the vehicle?
A: My left knee struck the lower part of the dashboard and console area when the airbag deployed and I was thrown
forward.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: Yes. I went to an urgent care clinic that afternoon, and I've been scheduled for an MRI and a follow-up with an
orthopedic specialist.
Q: Are you still experiencing pain or limited movement in the knee?
A: Yes. It swells when I stand for long periods, and I can't fully bend it. I've been using crutches for a few days.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll send any medical records you request.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
